title: The Horizon Game
lead_in: The line can be a horizon, roofline, bridge, wall, street edge, or long shadow.
prompt: Photograph the same strong horizontal line three ways: near the bottom third, near the top third, and through the center.
questions: Is the more interesting information above or below the line?
What changes when you move the line?
Does centering it create useful symmetry?
Would zooming in make the composition simpler?

variation.text: Choose your strongest line placement and add a foreground subject, such as a person, sign, plant, shadow, or bicycle.

review_prompt: Which line placement tells the clearest story, and why?
